metadata.dcterms:title: Some limits of the colored Jones polynomials of the figure-eight knot
metadata.dcterms:creator: KNOT, FIGURE-EIGHT
SPACES, ITS DEHN SURGERY
metadata.dcterms:abstract: We calculate limits of the colored Jones polynomials of the ﬁgure- eight knot and conclude that in most cases they determine the volumes and the Chern–Simons invariants of the three-manifolds obtained by Dehn surgeries along it.
